title: FlowDoc Frontend Expert Roadmap
summary: Record a bounded expert frontend roadmap before opening product implementation lanes, with Project Control-owned sequencing for Library, Design, Preview, Publish, and the WYSIWYG gate.
expectedOutput: Frontend Expert Roadmap v1 in Project Control, with lane-ready sequencing, scope boundaries, acceptance expectations, and no product repository changes.
